queries: Nvidia six million Blackwell GPUs shipped installed November 2025

sources_considered.why: Primary statement about installed GPU utilization; read_page returned full text. It does not quantify uninstalled inventory.
Read the keynote passage. It discusses shipments and package composition, not a count of operating installations.
Read the results release. Its sales and sold-out-cloud statements do not establish worldwide deployment or warehouse inventories.
Search surfaced a later market estimate discussing dies and packages. It was not used as verified evidence of November installations.

evidence_items.locator: CFO prepared remarks, paragraph preceding Record Q3 Data Center revenue

receipt.public_excerpt:
The clouds are sold out and our GPU installed base, both new and previous generations, including
Blackwell, Hopper, and Ampere, is fully utilized.

evidence_items.explanation: NVIDIA described strong utilization of installed GPUs shortly before the claim. This qualifies the broader picture but supplies neither an installed Blackwell count nor a warehouse count.

unresolved_gaps: No complete, dated count of installed and powered-on Blackwell GPUs was found.
No independently substantiated inventory of millions of warehoused GPUs was found.
The counting convention behind the six-million comparison remains material.
